Basic Nail Tech Program

Explore the skills and techniques covered in this program, taught through the Nail Revolution academy.

Your curriculum

Module 1Introduction to Nail Technology
  • Overview of the course
  • Importance of nail care and hygiene
Module 2Nail Shapes
  • Different nail shapes (e.g., square, oval, almond, coffin, stiletto)
  • Choosing the right shape for clients
Module 3Nail Anatomy
  • Structure of the nail (e.g., nail plate, cuticle, nail bed)
  • Understanding nail growth
Module 4Types of Nails
  • Natural nails vs. artificial nails
  • Different types of artificial nails (e.g., acrylic, gel, dip powder)
Module 5Nail Prep
  • Preparing the natural nail for application
  • Importance of proper nail preparation
Module 6Gel Polish Application
  • Steps for applying gel polish
  • Tips for a long-lasting gel polish application
Module 7Gel Extensions Detailed Procedure
  • Step-by-step process for gel extensions
  • Nail extension techniques
Module 8Gel Polish Removal
  • Safe gel polish removal techniques
  • Avoiding damage to the natural nail
Module 9Extension Removal
  • Removing nail extensions without causing harm
  • Proper tools and techniques for extension removal
Module 10Nail Art Techniques
  • Ombré Art: Gradient nail designs using a sponge or brush
  • French Tips: Classic white tip manicure techniques
  • Dotting Tool Art: Creating designs with dotting tools
  • Marble Art: Creating marble effects using nail polish
  • Freehand Art: Creating intricate designs without stencils or guides
Module 11Practice and Application
  • Hands-on practice of all techniques
  • Creating nail art designs on tips or practice hands
Module 12Client Consultation and Communication
  • Interacting with clients to understand their preferences
  • Providing recommendations based on client needs
Module 13Health and Safety
  • Importance of sanitation and hygiene in nail technology
  • Preventing the spread of infections
Module 14Business Basics
  • Setting up a nail tech business
  • Marketing and promoting nail services
Module 15Final Assessment and Certification
  • Practical and theoretical assessment
  • Certification upon successful completion
